Title: 503183-2026: Italy – Engineering services – AT858/2026 Award of design services (PFTE, PE) and safety coordination (UF1, UF2) – Adaptation of the Canova viaduct (SS12 Tangenziale di Trento). Project S-55
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Refurbishment/adaptation of a road viaduct (Viadotto Canova) is highly relevant for sbp, as road bridges and rehabilitation tasks are among our core interests. Points deducted due to missing information on spans/size and because the project is located in Italy (not DACH/Africa).
titel: AT858/2026 Design services and safety coordination for the adaptation of the Canova viaduct, SS12 Tangenziale di Trento
kurzbeschreibung: Design for the adaptation of a road viaduct in Trento, including safety coordination.
umfang: Design contract for the adaptation of the Canova viaduct at km 382+124 on the SS12 Tangenziale di Trento; functional units UF1 and UF2; no information on spans, length, width, or structural parameters in the notice.
leistungen: Engineering design services for PFTE and detailed design PE as well as safety coordination in the design phase for UF1 and UF2; PE for UF1 fixed, option for PE for UF2.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• Road bridges and viaducts are generally highly relevant for sbp, especially for adaptation and strengthening measures.
• This is an early and comprehensive design contract including preliminary and detailed design as well as safety coordination.
• The estimated contract value is high and economically attractive.
• The exact structural type, spans, and technical complexity are not described in the notice, therefore no maximum rating.
• Project in Italy is generally suitable for sbp as an internationally active engineering firm.
baukosten_erklaerung: No construction costs stated in the notice. Only the estimated value of the design contract of 3964836.73 EUR is given. For a reliable estimate of cost groups 300 and 400, information on structure size, spans, number of spans, degree of intervention, construction method, and scope of structural adaptation is missing. Roughly, the underlying construction volume for an infrastructure project with this fee sum could clearly be in the double-digit million range, but cannot be reliably quantified here.
referenzen_qualifikationen: Registration in a relevant professional register; registration in the commercial register; general annual turnover; further economic or financial requirements; professional liability insurance; evidence of quality assurance standards; evidence of environmental management systems or standards.
zuschlagskriterien: Most economically advantageous tender based on quality; exact weightings not stated in the notice.
auftraggeber: Provincia Autonoma di Trento, 38122 Trento, Italy, Contact: Silvano Librera, E-Mail: direzionegenerale@pec.provincia.tn.it, Telefon: +390461495111, Website: https://www.provincia.tn.it/
notes: Estimated contract value excluding VAT: 3964836.73 EUR. Duration 270 days. Electronic submission of tenders via https://contracta.provincia.tn.it/. Language of tenders: Italian. Green procurement in accordance with national environmental criteria is planned. Additional information and documents at https://sicopat2.provincia.tn.it/trasparenza-fe/#/procedura?uuid=3333ca81-fb54-4e65-a054-c3c6dae08026
